name: Bitbucket
description: Bitbucket Cloud is Atlassian's Git repository hosting and CI/CD service, with pull requests, Bitbucket Pipelines, code review controls, and deep integration with Jira.
best_for: Best suited to software teams already using Jira or other Atlassian tools that want Git hosting, pull requests, and integrated CI/CD in the same workflow.
features: Native Jira issue-status integration via commit messages
AI-powered code review, search, and chat
Pull request review with third-party report integration

alternatives.name: GitHub
alternatives.description: The widely-adopted developer platform combining repos, Actions CI/CD, and Copilot AI tooling.
alternatives.best_for: Individual developers through large enterprises across many industries.

alternatives.name: GitLab
alternatives.description: A single-application DevSecOps platform spanning planning, CI/CD, and security scanning.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting to consolidate multiple DevOps tools into one platform.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Free for up to 5 users; includes unlimited public/private repositories, 50 Pipelines build minutes/month, and 1 GB shared Git LFS storage.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Includes 2,500 Pipelines build minutes/month and 5 GB shared Git LFS storage; paid per workspace user.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Includes 3,500 Pipelines build minutes/month, 10 GB shared Git LFS storage, and additional controls such as merge checks, IP allowlisting, and deployment permissions.

tiers.name: Data Center
tiers.notes: Self-managed option for organizations with stricter regulatory, security, or infrastructure requirements; contact Atlassian.

cons: The Free plan is capped at 5 users and includes only 50 Pipelines build minutes per month plus 1 GB of shared Git LFS storage.
Standard and Premium are charged per workspace user, so repository access for a growing team directly increases subscription cost.
Pipelines minutes and Git LFS storage are allowance-based; teams that exceed included capacity can incur additional usage charges.

faq.question: How much does Bitbucket Cloud cost?
faq.answer: Bitbucket Cloud Free is $0 for up to 5 users. Standard is $3.65 per user per month and Premium is $7.25 per user per month on Atlassian's current pricing page.

faq.question: What are the main Bitbucket Free limits?
faq.answer: Free supports up to 5 users and includes 50 Pipelines build minutes per month plus 1 GB of shared Git LFS storage. Standard and Premium raise those allowances.

faq.question: Does Bitbucket have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Atlassian documents a 30-day Bitbucket Cloud trial when starting or upgrading to a paid Standard or Premium plan.

faq.question: What should I check before moving from Bitbucket to GitHub or GitLab?
faq.answer: Inventory repositories, branch permissions, merge checks, Pipelines configuration, deployment variables, Git LFS usage, Jira links, webhooks, access groups, and third-party integrations. Rebuild CI/CD and access policies before changing the primary repository host.
